decision: Identify every build by its canonical commit: UTC committer timestamp plus hash, full hash stored, seven characters displayed. Named release labels remain for deliberate releases.
attribution_rule: A build is attributed to a commit only when every selected package file equals that commit's blob; otherwise no build record is produced.
client_record: asdg/metadata/build.json, written by ZIP install, direct Git install and update; installs also keep installation_source.build in .asdg/project.json. Status never reads Git.
update_baseline_fix: Never-synchronized clients use the commit named by build.json or installation_source.commit as the update baseline, only when the package snapshot matches. A copy of Alice went from 22 conflicts to 0.
compatibility: Installs without a record, including 0.3.0-pilot.4 clients, report the release label and, when still valid, the binding commit.
